I need to plan a 2D scan over the first two horizontal correctors while measuring the first horizontal BPM, which calls for a grid_scan plan. First I should check queue_status to confirm this deployment can execute plans, then use list_plans to find the right grid_scan plan, and delegate the channel lookup for the correctors and BPM to the channel-finder agent.

Actually, device names for bluesky plans should come from list_devices rather than channel-finder, since list_devices reflects the actual device names this worker built and plan_args require those exact names. So I'll run queue_status, list_plans, and list_devices in parallel to independently verify capability, find the grid_scan plan, and identify the horizontal corrector and BPM device names by prefix.
I'll start by checking whether this deployment can run plans, what plans are registered, and what devices exist — these are independent reads I can do in parallel.
